name: Moon Illusion
source:
Hiruno Hirosuke is a normal woman.

Hiruno Hirosuke is a normal woman who has fallen in love. 

Hiruno Hirosuke has found God. 

I wonder what it feels like to be pinned in place, like a butterfly? 

[From [url=https://uraalice.itch.io/moon-illusion]itch.io[/url]]
